name: Blog News Addons For Elementor (News, Magazine and Blog Addons)
author: themeansar

sections.description:
Blog News for Elementor is a complete solution for bloggers, news portals, and magazine-style websites using Elementor.
This plugin adds 50+ advanced blog and news widgets designed to make your content look elegant, dynamic, and modern — without writing a single line of code.

Whether you’re building a personal blog, tech news site, or online magazine, Blog News for Elementor offers a variety of layouts, templates, and styling options that are fully compatible with both Elementor Free and Pro versions.

It works perfectly for:

News Portals & Media Publisher Websites

Online Magazines & Editorial Sites

Personal & Professional Blogs

Corporate blog sections

Content marketing agencies

Review and comparison sites

Every widget is built with SEO-friendly HTML structure, support for Schema Markup, and fast loading performance which helps your website appear more relevant and fast to search engines.

😲 Free Demo | 🔥 BlogNews Pro | 📃 Documentation

BlogNews Addons For Elementor is an all-in-one blog and news extension for Elementor Page Builder. It brings a comprehensive solution with 50+ specialized blog widgets, 12+ news modules, and 13+ pre-designed blog and news templates.

From the team behind NewsUp theme (50,000+ active installations), It’s a versatile toolkit packed with advanced widgets for blog posts, news articles, magazines, and publishing sites.

🔥 Key Features

50+ Blog & News Elementor Widgets – Specialized widgets designed specifically for content creators

14+ Ready Templates – Professional blog and news layouts for every niche

Performance Optimized – Lightweight code with selective widget loading

SEO Ready – Built following WordPress and SEO best practices

Mobile Responsive – All widgets work perfectly on mobile, tablet, and desktop

50+ Blog/News Widgets – Post Grid, Masonry, List, Sliders/Carousels, Magazine Blocks

Header–Footer Builder – Visual, brand-consistent navigation and footers

20+ Templates – News, Magazine, Blog, Corporate Newsroom

SEO-Friendly Markup – Semantic headings, schema-ready, minimal bloat

Performance-First – Lazy loading, image aspect-ratio control, fewer queries

Engagement Widgets – Trending, Related, Author Box, Social Share, Next/Prev

Advanced Pagination – Numbers, AJAX “Load More”, Infinite Scroll

Single Post Enhancers – Reading time, breadcrumbs, meta controls

FREE BLOG & NEWS ELEMENTOR WIDGETS

✅ Post Grid – Create stunning blog post grids with multiple layouts, filtering, and pagination options.

✅ News Ticker – Display scrolling breaking news with customizable speed, direction, and styling.

✅ Magazine Layout – Build professional magazine-style layouts with featured posts and category sections.

✅ Author Box – Showcase author profiles with bio, social links, and recent posts.

✅ Post Carousel – Display posts in beautiful sliding carousel with navigation controls.

✅ Category Grid – Show post categories with featured images, post counts, and descriptions.

✅ Related Posts – Intelligent related content suggestions based on tags, categories, or custom criteria.

✅ Social Share – Comprehensive social sharing buttons with custom positioning and analytics.

✅ Post Slider – Display your posts in an elegant slider layout — ideal for featuring the latest news and updates.

✅ Featured Posts – Highlight important posts with large featured images and excerpts.

NUMBER OF THE WORDPRESS THEMES & PLUGINS SUPPORTS 🔗

News Blog Elemntor Addons Working with all theme, including:

✅ NewseBlog
✅ Newsup
✅ Blogus
✅ BlogData
✅ Newspaperup
✅ Newsxo
✅ BlogArise
✅ Newsair
✅ Newses
✅ Blogier
✅ Blogfull
✅ Hello Elementor
✅ Astra
✅ Blocksy
✅ GeneratePress
✅ Neve
✅ OceanWP
✅ And Many More

News Blog Elemntor Addons is compatible with all plugins, including:

✅ SureRank SEO
✅ Rank Math SEO
✅ Contact Form 7
✅ Easy Digital Downloads
✅ Gravity Forms
✅ WooCommerce
✅ Yoast SEO
✅ And many more

Quick Links

| BlogNews Home | Starter Sites | Documentation | Support | Check all BlogNews Elementor Widgets

🧭 Installation

  1. Upload the blognews-for-elementor folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins → Installed Plugins menu.
  3. Open any Elementor page and search for “Blog News” widgets.
  4. Drag, drop, and customize the design as you like!

OR

Install directly from the WordPress Dashboard:
– Go to Plugins → Add New
– Search for “Blog News for Elementor”
– Click Install Now, then Activate
sections.faq:
Does this work with Elementor free version?

  • Yes! BlogNews Addons works perfectly with the free version of Elementor. No need for Elementor Pro.

Can I import demos?

  • Yes, import 20+ templates and customize.

Compatible with SEO & cache plugins?

  • Yes (Yoast/Rank Math/AIOSEO; clear cache after changes).

Do you provide support?

  • Yes, we provide support through WordPress.org forums for free version users.

Works with my theme?

  • Yes, with most modern Elementor-friendly themes.
